website/components/carousel/custom-carousel/sizing.ts

Fit/height measurement for CustomCarousel — the
Sourcesrc/website/components/carousel/custom-carousel/sizing.ts
UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

startFitObserver

Wires a ResizeObserver on the host that re-runs _measureFit on width changes. Reports under FIT_EPS_PX of the last width are dropped — scrollbars appearing/disappearing and sub-pixel reflow would otherwise re-fit on every layout pass. The measurement defers one RAF so it runs post-layout, and ResizeObserver absence (old engines) degrades to the one-shot window-resize path.

  • @param c The CustomCarousel element.

measureFit

Decides whether the items fit side-by-side (no carousel chrome) or need the scroll track. Side-by-side requires: ≤2 items, viewport ≥ SIDE_BY_SIDE_BREAKPOINT, and projected total width ≤ host width. The projection mirrors the shadow-DOM contract in media-figure.scss + carousel-host.scss exactly: strip height is --mf-h (70dvh minus a pad under 1024, fixed $space-* steps above) clamped to the file's natural height, media width is aspect-driven and capped by the regular gutter cap, the landscape --mf-max-w ladder, AND the natural pixel width (calcMediaBox — WASM-backed, never upscales), floored at min(MEDIA_MIN_WIDTH, naturalW) on ≥375px viewports; each item adds its breakpoint padding + desktop side margin. Items missing intrinsic sizes use GENERIC_DIMENSIONS defaults (conservative portrait) so a partial CMS row can't silently flip to scroll mode.

  • @param c The CustomCarousel element.
  • @param observedWidth Fresh RO width when known — avoids a layout read.

onCarouselResize

Window-resize handler — isMobile is a live getter so the resize path only re-publishes the slide height.

  • @param c The CustomCarousel element.

isLandscapeItem

Detects whether a slide item is landscape (by class or aspect ratio).

  • @param item Slide descriptor.
  • @returns true if the item represents landscape orientation.

isPortraitItem

Detects whether a slide item is portrait.

  • @param item Slide descriptor.
  • @returns true if the item represents portrait orientation.

isMixedCarousel

Evaluates whether the carousel contains a mix of both landscape and portrait items.

  • @param items List of slide descriptors.
  • @returns true if both landscape and portrait items are present.

determineLandscapeRatio

Calculates the majority landscape aspect ratio key ('16:9' | '21:9' | '32:9') among the landscape items in the list. Compares each item's width/height ratio against the 16:9, 21:9, and 32:9 target ratios and selects the mode (majority proportion).

  • @param items List of slide descriptors.
  • @returns The majority aspect ratio key ('16:9', '21:9', '32:9'), or null if no landscape items.

getRatioMultiplier

Returns the numeric multiplier (w/h) for a given aspect ratio key.

  • @param ratio Aspect ratio key ('16:9' | '21:9' | '32:9').
  • @returns Numeric ratio (e.g. 16/9, 21/9, 32/9).

getSmallestPortraitRatio

Calculates the smallest portrait aspect ratio (height / width) among portrait items. Used in mixed carousels to anchor the uniform carousel height on mobile to the shortest portrait item.

  • @param items List of slide descriptors.
  • @returns Smallest portrait height-to-width ratio, or null if no portrait items with sizes.

setHeightVar

Publishes --carousel-item-height on the enclosing

and --carousel-media-height on the host: the aspect-corrected height ensuring all slides share one uniform height. In mixed carousels on mobile, the uniform height anchors to the shortest portrait item. The published height is also capped at the smallest natural item height — the strip may be less tall than the projection, but no slide may ever render taller than its source file's real pixels.

  • @param c The CustomCarousel element.
